title: modalpi harness spec
description: The contract between the modalpi service and the plugin. The service returns this; the plugin renders it through a vetted local template into a Modal deployment file. Deliberately data-only: no code, no shell strings, nothing the plugin will execute verbatim.

tier.description: How this spec was resolved. Surfaced to the user so they know whether they are getting a proven harness or a fresh guess.

verified.description: True only if this exact spec has booted successfully at least once.

derived_from.description: harness_id this was adapted from, for tier=near.

kb_entries_applied.description: KB entry ids folded into this spec, so a failure can be traced to the rule that produced it.

architecture.description: From config.json architectures[0], e.g. Qwen3NextForCausalLM. Drives KB matching.

family.description: Coarse grouping used for tier-2 adaptation, e.g. qwen3.8.

gated.description: If true the plugin must prompt for an HF token before deploying.

est_usd_per_hour.description: Computed server-side from a real price table, never by the model. Shown to the user before they approve the deploy.

image.description: Runnable image containing the engine, used for the Sandbox path (e.g. vllm/vllm-openai:v0.27.1). Unlike cuda_image this needs no build step.

clear_entrypoint.description: Clear the image ENTRYPOINT before running the command. vllm/vllm-openai ships ENTRYPOINT ["vllm","serve"], which double-invokes an explicit command. See KB vllm-image-entrypoint.

extra_packages.description: Additional pip specs. Kept as a list so the renderer quotes each one; never a joined command string.

max_num_seqs.description: Must be set explicitly for hybrid recurrent architectures; vLLM's CUDA default of 1024 exceeds available Mamba cache blocks on smaller cards. See KB gdn-max-num-seqs.

tool_call_parser.description: Must match what the model's chat template actually emits, not the family default. Qwen3.8 emits XML, so hermes silently mis-parses every call.

extra_flags.description: Escape hatch for cases the schema does not cover. Each element is one argv token; the renderer never splits on whitespace.

client.description: How the plugin should register this endpoint with pi once it is live.

compat.description: pi models.json compat block, e.g. supportsDeveloperRole:false, thinkingFormat:qwen-chat-template.

warnings.description: Human-readable caveats shown before deploy, e.g. 'this architecture has never been verified on this GPU'.
